content.text: {"notes":["The requested readout time is the absolute simulation time t=1.0 s; measured observations are supplied through t=0.2 s.","Joint angles and angular velocities are expressed in each joint’s local frame in rad and rad/s; angles are unwrapped right-hand angles.","Tip position is a world-frame vector in metres; the world convention is right-handed with x-forward, y-left, and z-up.","A +0.5 N·m pulse is scheduled on joint_1 over [0.4672, 0.5672) s; joint_limit_by_T indicates whether either joint reaches magnitude 2.8 rad by the readout time."]}
